title: DR-23: caller persists the out-of-sync mark
description: openmls_sqlite_storage keeps its connection private; sharing it would make Store !Send. Readings: (a) fork accessor + mimi-mls table; (b) the caller (agent) persists the mark and restores it via a setter after Member::load; (c) in-memory only. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: (b).
